environment.description: Provider executes inside a containerd-managed pod with a custom OCI runtime spec. The runtime spec applies a reduced capability bounding set via the container's config.json spec (OCI runtime-spec v1.0.2 compliant). Specifically, the process capabilities object has 'bounding', 'effective', 'inheritable', 'permitted', and 'ambient' arrays that exclude CAP_NET_RAW (index 13) and CAP_SYS_ADMIN (index 21). The container also runs with a seccomp profile that filters mount(2) syscall (nr 165 on x86_64) and socket(2) with domain AF_PACKET (type 3). Note: exec-type hooks using standard binaries like /bin/sh remain functional as CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_FOWNER are retained for file operations needed by the provider's normal resource lifecycle.

config.seccomp_profile: custom - blocks mount(2) nr165, socket(2) with AF_PACKET domain
config.network_policy: egress allowed to state store endpoint only on port 443
